newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PT Meta Epsi Duta Corp unit sets $50 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: PT Meta Epsi Duta Corp unit sets $50 mln FRN.

text.p: The following issue was announced by arranger Dongsuh Securities.
The issuer is a special-purpose vehicle established in the Netherlands. The issue is 100 percent guaranteed by PT Meta Epsi Duta Corp, which is the holding company of Medco Energi Corp .
The notes are secured by the common shares of Medco Energi Corp valued at 120 percent of the issue amount.
Proceeds of the facility will be used for refinancing existing debts and for general working capital. Details are as follows:
